name: Melanocyte MITF-M program for melanin pigmentation
rationale: All members concern melanocyte MITF-M target programs, melanocyte growth/differentiation and pigment production or light response; unlike confusables it carries melanin synthesis, pigment granule and light-response members and lacks the MITF-M cell-cycle, DNA-repair and MITF-M expression-control arms.

name: Cellular osmotic and salt balance via cation-chloride cotransporters
rationale: Members cover osmotic and salt stress responses, sodium/potassium/chloride transport and SLC12 cotransporter diseases (Bartter, Gitelman, ACCPN); confusables instead add K2P channels, aldosterone response, Na/H exchangers or P-type ATPases.

qualifier: from ER insertion to COPII export
name: Early secretory pathway from ER insertion to COPII export
rationale: Members span SRP and tail-anchored protein insertion into the ER membrane, ER retention and COPII cargo loading to ER-Golgi transport; confusables add ER folding, ERAD or COPI retrograde traffic, or lack the COPII export arm.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling with SERCA reuptake
rationale: All members regulate ryanodine-receptor release, ER/SR calcium import and cytosolic calcium clearance; unlike the cardiac-contraction confusable it includes ATPase-coupled SR calcium import and caffeine response.

name: Erythroid lineage differentiation driven by transcriptional programs
rationale: Members are erythrocyte differentiation terms and erythroid modules (TAL1-GFI1B commitment, late red cell maturation) plus transcriptional regulators of cell development; confusables add stem-cell hemopoiesis or the megakaryocyte/platelet arm.

name: Urea cycle with ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency
rationale: Members are urea cycle, citrulline/arginine synthesis and OTC variant diseases; confusables cover other urea-cycle enzyme deficiencies or ornithine/ammonium metabolism without OTC defects.

name: Antimicrobial protein killing of fungi and Gram-positive bacteria
rationale: Members describe direct killing/cytolysis of microbes, metal sequestration by antimicrobial proteins and antifungal and Gram-positive defense; confusables centre on respiratory burst, Gram-negative killing, degranulation or iron assimilation.

qualifier: from intestinal uptake to glycogen storage
name: Glucose assimilation from intestinal uptake to glycogen storage
rationale: Members span dietary carbohydrate digestion, hexose transport and its disorders, glucokinase, and glycogen synthesis, breakdown and storage diseases; confusables lack glycogen (galactose, urate) or lack intestinal absorption (glycolysis, gluconeogenesis, fructose).

name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signaling in tumour suppression
rationale: Members are TGF-beta/BMP/activin/AMH receptor and SMAD signaling, its cancer receptor/SMAD mutants and RUNX3 pro-apoptotic targets; confusables lack the cancer mutants and RUNX3 targets or emphasise extracellular ligand sequestration, NODAL, YAP or Wnt.

name: T and B cell antigen-receptor signaling tuned by co-receptors
rationale: Members are TCR and BCR proximal signaling with CD28 costimulation, CTLA4/BTLA/CD22 co-inhibition and PECAM1; confusables are T-cell-only activation and thymic differentiation sets.

name: Epithelial solute carrier uptake of amino acids and peptides
rationale: Members are plasma membrane solute carriers and their renal/intestinal diseases, dominated by amino acid and oligopeptide transport plus urate and organic anions; confusables shift to organic cations, cationic amino acids or hexoses.

name: Vessel growth and remodelling by endothelium and smooth muscle
rationale: Members cover VEGF/Tie-driven sprouting angiogenesis and endothelial behavior plus vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration and phenotypic switching; confusables lack either the smooth muscle arm or the VEGF/Tie angiogenic arm.

name: Amino acid metabolism featuring tyrosine catabolism
rationale: All members are amino acid biosynthesis or catabolism (proline, glycine, glyoxylate, phenylalanine, tyrosine); most confusables lack the tyrosine/phenylalanine catabolism members while one lacks proline and glycine synthesis.

qualifier: from mesenchymal progenitors under RUNX2 control
name: Mesenchymal-to-osteoblast differentiation under RUNX2 control
rationale: Members concern mesenchymal stem cell and osteoblast proliferation/differentiation via RUNX2, Wnt and mechanical loading; confusables add chondrocyte, collagen or osteoclast processes and lack the RUNX2 osteoblast members.

name: B cell development and activation via BCR signaling
rationale: Members are B cell development, proliferation, homeostasis and BCR signaling modules; confusables carry T cell, plasma cell or B cell subset signatures and lack the BCR signaling cascade.

name: MECP2 neuronal gene regulation with sensory behavior phenotypes
rationale: Most members are MECP2 transcriptional control and its loss-of-function defects with HDAC and translational repression, alongside touch, proprioception and visual behaviors; confusables lack MECP2 or extend to motor and vocal behaviors.

name: RNA polymerase II transcription regulation, initiation to termination
rationale: Members regulate Pol II preinitiation, elongation, poly(A)-coupled termination and R-loops, with transcription-control modules; confusables are elongation-complex, chromatin/ubiquitin modules or Pol I/III and RNA processing.

name: Muscle calcium release control restraining cardiac contraction
rationale: Members regulate sequestered calcium release, Na/Ca exchange and cytosolic calcium reduction with negative cardiac contraction and heart rate; confusables emphasise SERCA reuptake or positive force and rate.

name: p53 transcriptional induction of apoptosis via BH3-only proteins
rationale: Members are TP53 transcription of death genes, PUMA/NOXA activation, BH3-only inhibition of BCL-2 and cytochrome c release; confusables cover BAX/BAK oligomerization or generic p53-mediator apoptosis regulation.

qualifier: from follicle growth to luteal regression
name: Ovarian cycle from follicle growth to corpus luteum regression
rationale: Members span follicle development, oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis and estrous cycle; confusables centre on gonadotropin secretion and hormone response.

name: Neutral amino acid transport across the plasma membrane
rationale: Members are amino acid carriers and their defects (SLC6A19 Hartnup, SLC1A1, SLC6A14, proton-coupled transporters) moving mostly neutral amino acids; confusables add imino-acid/glycine (iminoglycinuria), cystine or peptide transport.

name: Centrosomal microtubule organization for spindle positioning
rationale: Members concern centrosome cohesion and positioning, MTOC nucleation/anchoring and spindle orientation in asymmetric division; confusables add centriole duplication, mitotic centrosome recruitment or contractile ring cytokinesis.

core: Protein delivery to the plasma membrane
name: Protein delivery to the plasma membrane by endocytic recycling
rationale: Members regulate endosome-to-plasma-membrane recycling, receptor recycling, endocytosis and constitutive secretion; confusables are Golgi-endosome-lysosome retrograde traffic and Rab/ARF signaling.

name: Cardiac muscle growth and adaptation with contractile enhancement
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, hypertrophy, regeneration and sarcomere organization plus positive contraction and heart rate; confusables are calcineurin-NFAT growth or vascular smooth muscle sets.

name: Golgi architecture remodelling including membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly, reassembly, positioning and membrane tubulation; confusables cover Golgi protein retention, COPI traffic or general vesicle docking.

qualifier: by glycosylase excision or direct reversal
name: Damaged base repair by glycosylase excision or direct reversal
rationale: Members are base excision repair steps and glycosylase defects plus ALKBH/MGMT direct alkylation reversal; confusables add mismatch repair, interstrand cross-link repair or lack the reversal enzymes.

name: Rho-subfamily and CDC42 GTPase activation cycles
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles of RHOA/B/C/D/G/J and CDC42 with formin activation; confusables emphasise RAC, RND or RHOU/V cycles and IQGAP/ROCK/PAK effectors.

name: Hepatic bilirubin clearance and inherited hyperbilirubinemias
rationale: Members cover heme degradation, organic anion uptake, UGT1A conjugation and ABCC2 export with their hyperbilirubinemia defects; confusables are drug ADME and xenobiotic transport.

qualifier: from defective proline and glycine transporters
name: Iminoglycinuria from defective proline and glycine transporters
rationale: All three members are SLC36A2/SLC6A20 defects causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria; confusables cover other amino acid, hexose or urate transport.

name: Cerebellar and striatal development underpinning motor coordination
rationale: Members are locomotion, proprioception, motor learning and righting reflex with cerebellar layer and striatum formation; confusables add vocal, auditory and sensory behaviors or glial and nigral development.
